anti_generic_signature_read: Not a plain egg or standing top. The seed silhouette has a micropyle bead at one pole and a planar knock face opposed by a rounded belly.
blind_action_read: The signature strip shows three exact poses of the same seed: resting on the planar face, tipped off that face, and lying on the rounded belly.
blind_form_read: An elongated seed-shaped ovoid, not a plaque or sphere. One side sits on a planar face; the opposite surface is a rounded belly. One pole carries a small rounded micropyle bead.
blind_held_read: No hand is in frame. A single palm-scale brown seed floats above a soft shadow on a cream field. It is a one-piece holdable solid, broader at one pole and tapered at the other.
blind_relationship_read: The planar face is the table contact in the left pose. The rounded belly is the down surface in the right pose. There are no other parts.
blind_subjects_read: One brown seed-shaped solid. The isometric view shows it once. The signature strip shows three poses of that same body.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: Iso and signature show a single palm-scale brown seed-shaped solid with no other parts.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: The object is a tiny one-piece seed, not a board, plaque, or multi-part machine.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The right signature pose lies on the convex belly; the iso shows the same rounded dorsal curve.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: A rounded belly is the spin contact.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The left signature pose rests on a flattened face that is a different surface from the rounded belly.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: It always settles on the same distinct face.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The three-state sheet is rest on the face, tipped off that face, and lying on the belly, the cycle a flick would drive.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: A fingertip flick sends it turning, then it knocks onto that face.

critical_form_requirements.blind_evidence: The planar knock face is readable against the rounded belly; there are no ports, wires, or extra parts.
critical_form_requirements.requirement: It is not a spherical weeble that hides the face, and not electronics.

largest_risk: Preview STL shading still shows polygonal facets on the curved seed. The STEP solid is smooth. Digital images cannot prove the knock is audible on a real table.
resolution: Round 1 read a squat hat-like top. The body was rebuilt as a lying seed with a planar knock face, rounded belly, and micropyle bead. Round 2 read that seed and the face-versus-belly pairing.
